transcript: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy. Chlorophyll absorbs sunlight in leaves. Plants use carbon dioxide and water to produce glucose and oxygen.
The water cycle moves water through the environment. Evaporation changes liquid water into vapor. Condensation forms clouds and precipitation returns water to Earth.
A stack follows the last in first out rule. Push adds an item to the top. Pop removes the most recent item from the stack.
An algorithm is a finite sequence of instructions. Binary search works on sorted data. Each comparison halves the remaining search interval.
The Constitution defines the structure of government. Fundamental rights protect individual freedoms. The judiciary interprets laws and reviews government action.
Supply is the quantity sellers offer at different prices. Demand is the quantity buyers want. Market equilibrium occurs when supply equals demand.
Sound travels as a mechanical wave through a medium. Frequency determines perceived pitch. Amplitude is related to loudness.
The heart pumps blood through the circulatory system. Arteries carry blood away from the heart. Veins return blood toward the heart.
A database stores structured information. A primary key uniquely identifies a row. SQL queries retrieve and update records.
Renewable energy comes from replenishing sources. Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity. Wind turbines use moving air to generate power.
Newton's first law describes inertia. An object maintains its state unless a net external force acts. Mass measures resistance to acceleration.
DNA carries hereditary information in cells. Genes are segments of DNA. Proteins perform many structural and chemical functions.
The Indian monsoon brings seasonal rainfall. Moist winds move from ocean toward land. Rainfall patterns affect agriculture and reservoirs.
Encryption transforms readable data into ciphertext. A key controls encryption and decryption. Strong keys help protect confidential information.
The CPU executes program instructions. RAM holds temporary working data. Storage devices retain information when power is off.
A habitat provides food and shelter for organisms. Biodiversity describes the variety of life. Conservation protects species and ecosystems.
The derivative measures instantaneous rate of change. A slope describes direction and steepness. Calculus studies change and accumulation.
A circuit needs a closed path for current to flow. Voltage is electrical potential difference. Resistance opposes current.
The immune system detects pathogens. Antibodies bind to specific targets. Vaccination trains immune responses before exposure.
A republic elects representatives to make public decisions. Citizens participate through voting. Accountability connects officials to the public.
Machine learning finds patterns from examples. Training adjusts model parameters. Testing estimates performance on unseen data.
The pH scale describes acidity and alkalinity. A lower pH is more acidic. Neutral water is near pH seven under standard conditions.
Plate tectonics explains movement of Earth's lithosphere. Plates interact at boundaries. Their motion can produce earthquakes and volcanoes.
A project plan lists tasks and dependencies. Milestones mark important progress points. Risk management prepares responses to uncertainty.
The scientific method uses observation and testing. A hypothesis is a testable explanation. Reproducible results support reliable conclusions.
Inflation is a general rise in prices over time. A consumer price index tracks a basket of goods. Central banks monitor inflation trends.
A compiler translates source code into another form. Parsing checks grammatical structure. Optimization can improve execution efficiency.
An ecosystem includes living organisms and their surroundings. Food webs represent feeding relationships. Energy flows through trophic levels.
The nervous system sends signals through neurons. The brain processes information. Reflexes can produce rapid responses to stimuli.
Cloud computing provides network access to shared resources. Virtualization allows multiple isolated machines. Elastic scaling adjusts capacity to demand.
